title: Network Security Engineering
description:
Full Time Role WIth MNC Client Role : Network Security Engineering 
 Primary skill: F5 LB with LTM & GTM must Good to have: Fortigate firewall/Zscaler/AWS(for C1 Band) Shift: should be comfortable for 24/7 including night shift. 
 Experience: 8 + Years Location: Pune, Greater Noida,Hyderabad,Mysore,Coimbatore,Chennai,Kolkata,Jaipur,Mumbai 

 Key Responsibilities: Fortinet Firewall Management: Configure, manage, and maintain Fortinet Firewalls (FortiGate) for enterprise-grade security. Perform advanced troubleshooting of FortiGate firewalls to resolve network security issues and optimize firewall policies and rule sets. FortiManager & FortiAnalyzer: Utilize FortiManager to manage, configure, and automate firewall policies and rules across multiple FortiGate devices. Leverage FortiAnalyzer for log aggregation, reporting, and event analysis to proactively identify and mitigate security risks. VPN Configuration & Troubleshooting: Configure and manage secure VPNs (IPsec, SSL VPN, site-to-site VPN, and remote access VPN) ensuring secure communication for remote users and sites. Diagnose and resolve VPN connectivity issues, performance degradation, and ensure high availability of VPN tunnels. F5 Load Balancer Administration: Configure, manage, and troubleshoot F5 Load Balancers to ensure high availability, scalability, and optimal performance for applications and services. Design, implement, and maintain load balancing configurations for internal and external applications, including SSL offloading, traffic distribution, and health checks. Automation: Experience on Automation tools like Algosec and Appviewx Network Security Design & Architecture: Design and implement security architecture for the organization's network, ensuring compliance with best practices and security standards. Perform security assessments and audits, recommending improvements to enhance overall network security posture\ Documentation & Reporting: Create detailed documentation for network security configurations, policies, and incident resolutions. Produce regular reports for senior management on security performance, network issues, and recommendations for improvements. Mentorship & Leadership: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and other team members. Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with network, systems, and security teams to improve the organization's overall security posture. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications: Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience in network security engineering, with hands-on expertise in Fortinet Firewalls, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, VPN configuration, and F5 Load Balancers. In-depth knowledge of Fortinet products and their integration into enterprise environments. Proven experience in configuring, troubleshooting, and optimizing F5 Load Balancers for high-availability applications. Certifications:Fortinet NSE 4/5/7 certification is required. F5 Certified Technology Specialist (F5-CTS) or equivalent is a plus. Additional certifications such as Cisco CCNP Security, CompTIA Security+, or other security-related certifications are advantageous. Technical Skills: Deep expertise in configuring and managing Fortinet Firewalls (FortiGate) and utilizing FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer. Advanced knowledge of VPN protocols (IPsec, SSL, remote access, site-to-site). Hands-on experience with F5 Load Balancer administration and troubleshooting (SSL offloading, application traffic distribution, and high-availability setup). Experience with network automation using tools like Ansible, Python, or other scripting technologies. Familiarity with network monitoring tools, SIEM solutions, and IDS/IPS technologie Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to resolve complex network security issues. Excellent communication skills to convey technical concepts and issues to non-technical stakeholders Ability to work in a collaborative, team-oriented environment and take ownership of initiatives

Key Skills: Gtm,Ltm,Load Balancing,F5,Fortigate Firewall,VPN Configuration,Zscaler,Troubleshooting

description:
**Job Description**
**Resident Engineer – Audio Visual , Video Conferencing \& IT Infrastructure**
**Location**
 NICL Headquarters, Rajarhat, Kolkata
   

  

**Employment Type**
 Full\-Time (On\-site)
   

  

**Contract Duration**
 Initially for
 **5 years** 
 , extendable as per project requirements.
   

  

**Working Hours**
* Monday to Saturday
* 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (9 Hours)
* Availability beyond office hours, Sundays, and holidays during emergencies or whenever called upon.


**Job Summary**
 The RE will be responsible for the day\-to\-day operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, monitoring, and support of the Audio Visual , Video Conferencing , networking, and related IT infrastructure deployed at NICL Headquarters. The RE shall ensure maximum system uptime, adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and seamless support during meetings, conferences, and critical events.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AV \& Video Conferencing Support**
* Operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain all AV and Video Conferencing systems.
* Provide real\-time technical support during meetings, conferences, presentations, and official events.
* Configure and troubleshoot VC endpoints, cameras, microphones, DSPs, displays, LED walls, projectors, and control systems.
* Ensure readiness of conference rooms before scheduled meetings.


**System Maintenance**
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of all AV and VC equipment.
* Monitor overall health and performance of installed systems.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and integration issues.
* Coordinate with OEMs and service partners for escalations and warranty support.


**Network \& IT Support**
* Support network connectivity related to AV and VC solutions.
* Assist in basic network management, IP configuration, VLAN connectivity, and device communication.
* Support IT security practices applicable to AV and VC infrastructure.
* Ensure firmware and software updates are applied as approved.


**Incident Management**
* Attend all complaints within defined SLA timelines.
* Record, track, and close incidents through the prescribed ticketing mechanism.
* Escalate unresolved issues appropriately.
* Maintain complaint history and resolution records.


**Documentation**
* Maintain preventive maintenance records.
* Maintain inventory of installed equipment.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
* Maintain asset movement and service logs.
* Update network diagrams and system documentation whenever required.


**Coordination**
* Coordinate with NICL officials, OEMs, and implementation teams.
* Assist during system upgrades, expansions, relocations, and testing activities.
* Support acceptance testing and performance verification.


**Educational Qualification**
* Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in:
+ Electronics \& Communication Engineering
+ Electrical Engineering
+ Computer Science
+ Information Technology
+ Electronics \& Instrumentation
+ or Equivalent discipline


**Experience**
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in:
+ Audio Visual (AV) Solutions
+ Video Conferencing Systems
+ Network Management
+ IT Security Management


**Mandatory Certifications**
* Relevant AVIXA Certification (CTS/CTS\-I/CTS\-D) or
* Equivalent OEM Certification on the proposed AV/VC solution.


**Technical Skills**
 The engineer should have hands\-on knowledge of:
   

  

* Professional Audio\-Visual Systems
* Video Conferencing Platforms
* DSP Programming \& Configuration
* Audio Mixing Systems
* Wireless \& Wired Microphones
* PTZ Cameras
* LED Displays and Video Walls
* Projectors and Display Systems
* AV Control Systems
* Matrix Switchers
* Signal Distribution Systems
* IP Networking
* TCP/IP, VLAN, DNS, DHCP
* Windows Operating System
* Basic Linux Administration (desirable)
* Network Monitoring Tools
* IT Security Best Practices
* Preventive Maintenance Procedures
* Incident \& SLA Management


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Good verbal and written communication.
* Customer\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work under pressure during critical meetings.
* Good documentation skills.
* Team coordination and stakeholder management.


**Employment Conditions**
* The RE shall be a direct employee of the successful bidder and not employed through any franchisee or subcontractor.
* The engineer must possess a valid company\-issued Identity Card.
* Deployment is subject to successful interview and approval by NICL officials.
* NICL reserves the right to seek replacement of the engineer if performance is found unsatisfactory.
* Frequent rotation of the RE shall not be permitted. Any change shall require prior written intimation to NICL except under unavoidable circumstances.
* The successful bidder shall provide an assurance that the deployed engineer meets all qualification requirements and has been fully trained on the proposed solution before deployment.
* In case of engineer replacement, a minimum 15\-day knowledge transfer (KT) period shall be ensured before relieving the existing engineer.
* The bidder shall arrange additional manpower whenever required to maintain system uptime and comply with SLA commitments, without any additional cost to NICL.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* System uptime as per SLA.
* Incident response and resolution time.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Documentation accuracy.
* Timely escalation and closure of incidents.
* Compliance with NICL operational and security policies.

 GVR Technolabs Pvt Ltd, an Information Technology services company with expertise

 quality and value in a secure environment.

 (ECE), or Electronics & Electrical Engineering (EEE)

 We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Service Engineer to join our team. 
 The ideal candidate will be responsible for installation, testing, troubleshooting, 
 maintenance, and support of electronic systems, networking infrastructure, and

 •

 Troubleshoot network issues related to TCP/IP protocols and LAN topologies. 
 Documentation & Compliance: 
 •
 •
 •
 Review and understand software test documents, technical manuals, and system

 performance. 
 Ensure compliance with organizational procedures and quality standards. 
 Test Instruments & Diagnostic Tools: 
 •
 •

 equipment.

 troubleshooting. 
 Conduct diagnostics and performance validation of hardware and 
 communication systems.

 Familiarity with networking protocols, managed switches, and server 
 configurations. 
 •

 Experience using electronic test instruments and diagnostic tools.
